Please take this proposal to [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions); new features need approval there before an issue is filed. In the meantime, you can subclass `RegexHighlighter` with a named group for units and assign its style through a custom `Theme`; see [custom highlighting](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst) and [customizing styles](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
